source: scratchpad/gauntlet/L74/plan1026/PLAN.md Pillar 2 + REPORT_opponents.md section 4; numbers copied, none tuned on baseline scores
rule: every pass is an equivalence test; a cell with too little data FAILS (never passes by default)

A.agreement_ceiling_method: L67/agreement_ceiling.py, matched states, pro pairs at board distance < 0.25
A.memory_used: late-match (t > 120 s) NLL with the real memory beats a memory from another match by more than the seed gap

C.status: level C not built yet (later ticket); thresholds registered now

H.definition: H = sum_c w_c * pass_c; c = head deck (>= 200 held-out HF sides and in the live census) else archetype, per band; w_c = cell share of that band's live opponents

attribution_rule: if A-C pass and D fails, the gap is assigned to the engine or the bot's live execution, not the opponent
